sentences.text:
Instant bail application has been filed by petitioner under Section 483 of BNSS in connection with FIR No. 124/2024 registered at Police Station-Nawa, District- Deewana-Kuchaman for offences under Sections 498A, 406, 304-B & 120-B of IPC.
2.
Heard counsel for petitioner as well as learned Public Prosecutor and perused the material available on record, including the statement of complainant.

3. Taking into consideration the factual matrix of the case that the petitioner being husband has been implicated on account of death of his wife on 15.05.2024 and since death was occurred during a period of seven years from the date of their marriage, which was solemnized on 02.05.2023, an assumption of dowry death has been drawn against the petitioner.
(Uploaded on 06/12/2025 at 11:44:13 AM) [2025:RJ-JD:52295] (2 of 3) [CRLMB-14392/2024]
4. Petitioner is in custody since 21.06.2024, after investigation, charge-sheet has been filed, and during course of trial, statements of complainant(father of deceased) have been recorded.

A prima facie perusal of statement reveals that there is no concrete evidence of cruelty/harassment of his daughter for demand of dowry soon before death.

That apart, in the FIR and the previous statement, there is no such specific allegation of demand of dowry; further contradiction in his statements is apparent, as has been admitted by the complainant himself.
However, this Court refrains itself from evaluating the evidential value of his statements in detail and leave it open to be considered by the trial Court.
This Court has also looked into the PMR and medical opinion of deceased.
There are no physical injuries except Asphyxiation marks on the Neck.
6. Indisputably, the deceased died by hanging herself.
Out of wedlock, no child was born, petitioner is a Labour class person.

In addition, it has transpired that marriage was solemnized in exchange (common term "Aata sata") as the other two relatives of petitioner, brother of deceased, Gordhan and his brother-in-law- Shankar, entered into marriage with the girls, who fell in relation with petitioner.

7. Taking into consideration the overall facts and circumstances and no prima facie proof of demand of dowry and harassment of deceased since before death; considering the living standard and status of parties; petitioner is a person belonging to Labour Class; petition is in custody since 21.06.2024;
conclusion of trial may take considerable time, hence, this Court deems it just and proper to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
